thought.text: Composer 2.10.3 is ready on the host. Now let me run the other documented method — the "New installation" via `composer create-project drupal/openculturas_project`.

reasoning_content:
The Composer 2.10.3 installation is complete. Next, I'll try the documented "New Installation" method:

```bash
composer create-project --remove-vcs drupal/openculturas_project example.org
```

Note: CI runs this with `--no-interaction`. Since this is a template on drupal.org, it should exist on packagist. I'll run it in the workspace directory (keeping the project repository and artifacts inside it). This will create /workspace/example.org.

Since this will download a lot of packages, I'll run it in the background.

action.command:
cd /workspace && COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 nohup composer create-project --remove-vcs --no-interaction --ansi drupal/openculturas_project example.org > /tmp/create_project.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 nohup composer create-project --remove-vcs --no-interaction --ansi drupal/openculturas_project example.org > /tmp/create_project.log 2>&1 &\necho \"PID $!\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Run composer create-project openculturas_project in background"}

summary: Run composer create-project openculturas_project in background
